files.source.svg: author source SVG (from the paper's arXiv/source bundle)
files.preview.png: PNG render of the author SVG
files.print.png: the figure as extracted from the published PDF, at print size
files.semantics.json: full semantic record for this figure

templates.why_chosen: Only three logical components (clients / brokers / servers) wrapped in two labelled scope outlines that overlap deliberately.
templates.what_to_learn: Overlapping labelled scopes let one figure name two protocols over the same three tiers without drawing the tiers twice.
